plan.question: Bound compile-enabled-but-off overhead against original,then CPU-service-on overhead against the same off binary;collect conserved long-request service by format/NT.
plan.constants: Original6e40 versus its four scoped observer/test patches only;same selected math/configuration,1256slots,131072residentINT8,8192chunks,spec4,five workers+host. Common parameter validation,retained UR reference,stage trace,CPU census and nested decode clocks;only CPU_SERVICE0/1 and declared binary differ. Environment fixed before exec.
plan.decision: Complete all nine independent processes in three Latin-order triples. For each triple compare off/original and on/off actual token throughput for prefill/decode separately. Off/original needs geomean>=0.98 and every ratio>=0.95 in both phases. On/off decode needs geomean>=0.95 and every ratio>=0.90;prefill needs0.98/0.95. Each pairing additionally needs CPU entries per emitted token within5%,each format/NT job count normalized to equal emitted tokens within5% or two jobs for small bins,and absolute MTP acceptance difference<=0.02,otherwise overhead is confounded. Code acceptance>=0.60 is recorded separately;no weak-pair claim. No speed-based early stopping.
plan.stopping: Stop first source/runtime/owner/fault/budget/native/request/census/observer error;no retries,replacements or order changes. Commit every process outcome before next launch. Full model hashes before cohort and after final process;inventory/stat/ctime checked each launch and exit.
plan.retention: Keep individual samples,paired decisions and conserved on-arm format/NT service needed to choose the next CPU leaf calibration. Retire successful raw traces/logs/cache after each committed process. Keep only three generated inputs per planned process through cohort closure;retire unused extra build/controllers after source recovery when comparison closes.
plan.limits: Observed workload-specific overhead and attribution only;not clean speed,physical RAM/PCIe traffic,CPU arithmetic saturation,inference adoption,task quality,weak-MTP,agent-session,262144-context,RESTORE or ordinary runtime destruction qualification.

observer_overhead_retirement.consumer: Frozen nine-process cohort;retain three generated admission inputs per planned process and both named engine builds through comparison closure. Native/model admission receipts remain live;successful raw output does not.

thread_service_followup.question: Check cumulative per-thread CPU leaf distribution before choosing a decode-pool scheduling calibration. run_split_multi_native uses3*(five workers+host)=18 equal-row tasks,while conserved format/NT service shows different work cost per row.
thread_service_followup.collection: Retain the six already-emitted CPU_SERVICE_THREAD rows for request5 of the final on arm;no new instrumentation,source,environment,workload,cohort order,overhead criteria or stopping change. Do not repeat retired samples.
thread_service_followup.validation: Bind to that native owner and the existing same-request service/census;require distinct six slots/owners and totals equal retained calls/wall_ns/cpu_ns. Existing reader has already checked stable TIDs across the five requests.
thread_service_followup.limits: One cumulative diagnostic can reveal skew,but cannot prove per-batch critical-path imbalance or arithmetic/RAM saturation. Leaf clocks omit pool/barrier/sleep/submission work and include memory stalls and charged clock costs.
thread_service_followup.consumer: Main next source-pinned decode-only row-task calibration after full cohort closure;preserve the selected prefill policy and use actual format/NT mix. Retire successful raw output after compact validation.
